items.prompt: Write a diary entry about your best day this month. Write six sentences.
hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: How did you feel and why?
items.model: Last Sunday was the best day this month. We went to my grandmother's house. She cooked my favourite soup. After lunch, my cousins and I played in the garden. We laughed a lot. I did not want to go home.

items.prompt: Write an email to a friend about your school. Tell your friend two things you like and one thing you do not like.
hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: Two good things and one bad thing.
items.model: Hi Maya, I want to tell you about my school. I like our library because it has lots of books. I also like football on Fridays. I do not like getting up early. Write soon! Best wishes, Dina

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Write a short story with a beginning, a middle and an end.

figure.alt: A boat, the sea and a whale.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

items.model: Last summer, Rafi went out on a small boat. Suddenly, a huge whale rose from the water next to him. Rafi was scared at first, but the whale was friendly. It swam beside the boat all the way home.

items.prompt: Some children go to school by bike, and some go by bus. Which is better? Write your opinion with two reasons.
hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

items.model: I think going by bike is better. First, it is good exercise. Second, it does not cost any money. However, a bus is safer when it rains.
